summary: Silver Point Specialty Lending Fund filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting that its Board of Trustees declared a regular monthly dividend on September 23, 2026, of $0.24 per common share for holders of record September 30, 2026, payable on or before October 30, 2026. The fund is a Maryland business development company-style vehicle trading over the counter with no exchange listing. No advisor, board recommendation beyond declaration, structural mechanics, or regulatory clock were disclosed. The risk-arb angle is nil; watch recurring monthly distribution rate, NII coverage, and any NAV erosion from the payout.
